name: Canaan
bio: Canaan is the son of Ham and grandson of Noah, the ancestor of the Canaanite peoples who later inhabited the land of Canaan. After Ham saw and dishonored his drunken, exposed father, Noah awoke and declared, "Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren" — so that Canaan bore the consequence of a curse brought on by his own father's disrespect (Genesis 9:22-27). This account also lays groundwork for Israel's later history of entering and warring against the peoples of Canaan.
